## Type of change

- [ ] New tutorial

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/hetzneronline/community-content/blob/master/contributing.md).
- [ ] No tutorial about the exact same topic exists yet (checked [community.hetzner.com](https://community.hetzner.com/tutorials) and open PRs).
- [ ] The folder name, the `path` and the `slug` in the front matter match.
- [ ] All [metadata fields](https://github.com/hetzneronline/community-content/blob/master/tutorial-template.md) required by the metadata schema are present.
- [ ] At least one file is English (`01.en.md`).
- [ ] The license block is included at the end of every tutorial file, with my name and email filled in.
- [ ] Images (if any) are stored in an `images/` subfolder next to the tutorial.
- [ ] Any external software, Docker image or Terraform module used is free, open source and trusted.
- [ ] This contribution is original and was not primarily or entirely generated by AI.
